title: The EU Code of Practice and future of AI in Europe
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI joins the EU Code of Practice, advancing responsible AI while partnering with European governments to drive innovation, infrastructure, and economic growth....
body:
